resources.string: Adds \"Send to Mirlo\" to the X app. Posts are queued in a folder that Syncthing carries to Mirlo-desktop.

1. In Syncthing, share a folder between this phone and ~/Mirlo/.inbox on your computer.
2. Pick that same folder below.
3. Patch X with LSPatch and enable this module for it.

Each send leaves a small <ID>.mirlo file there. Mirlo-desktop picks it up within seconds when it is open, or the next time you open it. Without the module you can still use Share → Send to Mirlo.
That is not a link to a post on X
